name: Enthrall
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Perform vs Insight against any number of creatures within medium range that can see and hear you. If you or your allies are in combat against a creature, its roll is favored. On each win, the creature's Awareness rolls are ill-favored while this spell lasts.

Describe your technique.
successes:
✨: On each win, the creature also takes -1d to its Awareness rolls.

🌞: On each win, the creature automatically fails its Awareness rolls. On each loss, the creature's Awareness rolls are ill-favored.
